blocks.text: 山頂一個黑狗兄 伊是牧場的少爺
blocks.spelling: suann-tíng tsi̍t ê oo-káu-hiann  i sī bo̍k-tiûnn ê siàu-iâ

blocks.text: 透早到晚真打拼 牧場開闊歸山拼
blocks.spelling: thàu-tsá kàu mî tsin phah-piànn  bo̍k-tiûnn khui-khuah kui suann piànn

blocks.text: 嘴唸明朗的歌聲 透日歌聲唸抹定
blocks.spelling: tshuì liām bîng-lóng ê kua-siann  thàu-li̍t kua-siann liām buē tīng

blocks.text: 伊的歌韻真好聽 聲好會唸介出名
blocks.spelling: i ê kua ūn tsin hó-thiann  siann hó ē liām kài tshut miâ

blocks.text: 有聽聲看無影 U Lay E Lee
blocks.spelling: ū thiann siann khuànn bô-iánn  U Lay E Lee

blocks.text: 歌喉響山嶺 U Lay E Lee
blocks.spelling: kua-âu liang suann-niá U Lay E Lee

blocks.text: 歌聲幼軟緣投得人疼 U Lay E Lee
blocks.spelling: kua-siann iù-nńg iân-tâu tìm lîn lâng thiànn  U Lay E Lee

blocks.text: 阮的貼心黑狗兄 逍遙自在真好命
blocks.spelling: gún ê tah-sim oo-káu-hiann  siau-iâu tsū-tsāi tsin hònn miā

blocks.text: 姑娘聽著心肝神魂跟伊行
blocks.spelling: koo-niû thiann-tio̍h sim-kuann sîn-hûn tuè i kiânn
iong sann thua sì kah i kiû tshin tshiânn
